name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 1 – Am 7
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 1a. Calls for the EU and its Member States to lead by example, in line with its values, in particular by refraining from the anti-democratic practices referred to in recital L, such as censorship, silencing, harassment of journalists and the use of SLAPPs;
